$comment: Per-sign structured hint cues across handshape/movement/location/orientation/timing/framing dimensions, per ARCHITECTURE.md#arch-vocab-hints. Each value describes the canonical ASL form for the sign, used by the hint engine to surface a targeted coaching cue when the pass/fail decision identifies a specific dimension of difficulty, and by the study-card UI as the 'how it's signed' reference. Cues are DESCRIPTIVE (factual about the canonical sign), never DIAGNOSTIC (never claim what the learner specifically did wrong). Covers the full 100-item vocabulary catalog (all 95 recognizer labels plus the 5 learn-only extras). Source-curated for source-aligned ASL 1 pilot use; no external Deaf-educator or ASL-instructor review is claimed by this file. The example at configs/sign-hints.example.json documents the format.

hello.handshape: Flat open hand with fingers extended and together.
hello.movement: Salute-style outward motion from the brow.
hello.location: Start at the side of the forehead near the temple.
hello.orientation: Palm faces forward, away from the body.
hello.framing: Keep face and signing hand visible together.

bye.handshape: Open hand with fingers spread loosely.
bye.movement: Small repeated wave; bend the fingers down and up.
bye.location: Shoulder height in front of the chest.
bye.framing: Keep the whole hand visible inside the camera frame.

thank_you.handshape: Flat open hand with fingers together.
thank_you.movement: Touch the chin, then move the hand outward and slightly down.
thank_you.location: Begin at the chin or lips.
thank_you.orientation: Palm starts facing inward, finishes facing up.
thank_you.framing: Keep the chin and the receiving direction in frame.

please.handshape: Flat open hand on the chest.
please.movement: Smooth small circles flat against the chest.
please.framing: Keep the chest and circling hand visible.

yes.movement: Small nodding motion at the wrist.
yes.timing: Two to three short nods, not one long stroke.
yes.framing: Keep the fist visible inside the frame.

no.handshape: Index and middle fingers extended, thumb meeting them.
no.movement: Snap the two fingers down to meet the thumb.
no.framing: Keep all three fingers in view at the closing moment.

mom.movement: Touch the chin with the thumb.
mom.orientation: Palm faces the side of the body, not the camera.
mom.framing: Keep the chin and thumb contact visible.

dad.movement: Touch the forehead with the thumb.
dad.orientation: Palm faces the side of the body, not the camera.
dad.framing: Keep the forehead and thumb contact visible.

book.movement: Open the hands like turning a book's pages.
book.location: Centered in front of the chest.
book.orientation: Palms start together, finish facing up.
book.framing: Keep both hands centered and fully visible.

water.handshape: W handshape (index, middle, and ring fingers extended).
water.movement: Tap the index finger to the chin a couple of times.
water.timing: Two short taps, not one long touch.
water.framing: Keep the chin and W handshape both in view.

milk.movement: Open and close the fist repeatedly, like a squeezing motion.
milk.orientation: Knuckles face forward or to the side.
milk.timing: Two or three squeezes at a steady rhythm.
milk.framing: Keep the fist visible and centered.

happy.movement: Brush upward on the chest one or two times.
happy.framing: Keep the chest and the brushing hand visible.

blue.handshape: B handshape (flat palm with thumb tucked against the palm).
blue.movement: Small side-to-side shake at the wrist.
blue.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
blue.framing: Keep the B handshape fully visible in the camera frame.

green.handshape: G handshape (thumb and index extended, others curled).
green.movement: Small side-to-side shake at the wrist.
green.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
green.orientation: Palm faces the side of the body.
green.framing: Keep the G handshape pinched fingers visible to the camera.

yellow.handshape: Y handshape (thumb and pinky extended, others curled).
yellow.movement: Small twist or shake at the wrist.
yellow.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
yellow.orientation: Palm faces forward or slightly to the side.
yellow.framing: Keep the Y handshape thumb and pinky visible together.

red.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers curled.
red.movement: Brush the index finger downward across the lips or chin once or twice.
red.orientation: Palm faces the body; fingertip touches the lips area.
red.framing: Keep the lips and signing hand visible together.

black.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers curled.
black.movement: Draw the index finger horizontally across the forehead.
black.location: Across the forehead, from one brow to the other.
black.orientation: Palm faces down; fingertip traces left-to-right across the brow.
black.framing: Keep the forehead and the tracing finger in the camera view.

aunt.handshape: A handshape (closed fist with the thumb resting alongside the index finger).
aunt.movement: Small side-to-side shake at the wrist near the cheek.
aunt.location: Beside the cheek or jaw on the dominant side.
aunt.framing: Keep the cheek and the A handshape both visible in the camera view.

uncle.handshape: U handshape (index and middle fingers extended and together; other fingers curled).
uncle.movement: Small side-to-side shake at the wrist near the temple.
uncle.location: Beside the temple on the dominant side.
uncle.framing: Keep the temple and the U handshape both visible in the camera view.

tv.handshape: Fingerspell T (fist with the thumb tucked between index and middle), then V (index and middle fingers extended in a vee).
tv.movement: Hold the T briefly, then switch cleanly to the V.
tv.location: Neutral signing space near shoulder height.
tv.orientation: Palm faces forward for both letters.
tv.timing: Two clear letter shapes, one after the other — not blended.
tv.framing: Keep the fingerspelling hand large and steady in the frame.

after.handshape: Both hands flat with fingers together.
after.movement: Rest the dominant hand on the back of the other hand, then slide it forward and off.
after.location: In front of the chest at a comfortable height.
after.orientation: Non-dominant palm faces down; dominant palm faces the body, then travels forward.
after.framing: Keep both hands and the forward slide inside the frame.

airplane.handshape: Thumb, index finger, and pinky extended; middle and ring fingers folded down.
airplane.movement: Glide the hand forward like a plane taking off, with a small repeated push.
airplane.location: Above shoulder height in open signing space.
airplane.timing: Two short forward glides rather than one long sweep.
airplane.framing: Keep the whole flight path inside the camera frame.

all.movement: Circle the dominant hand out, around, and land its back in the other palm.
all.orientation: Non-dominant palm faces in or up; dominant palm finishes facing up.
all.framing: Keep both hands visible through the whole circle.

animal.handshape: Both hands in bent-5 shapes (fingers spread and curved).
animal.movement: With fingertips anchored on the chest, rock both hands toward and away from each other.
animal.location: Fingertips rest on the upper chest.
animal.timing: Two or three gentle rocking motions.
animal.framing: Keep the chest and both elbows inside the frame.

another.handshape: A handshape with the thumb extended.
another.movement: Pivot the wrist so the thumb arcs up and over to point to the side.
another.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
another.orientation: Palm starts facing down and rotates to the side as the thumb points.
another.framing: Keep the thumb's full arc inside the frame.

any.handshape: A handshape with the thumb extended.
any.movement: Twist the wrist while moving the hand across to the side.
any.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
any.orientation: Palm rotates from facing in to facing down as the hand moves.
any.framing: Keep the sideways travel of the hand visible in the frame.

apple.handshape: Bent index finger knuckle (X handshape), other fingers closed.
apple.movement: Press the knuckle to the cheek and twist forward and back.
apple.location: On the cheek near the corner of the mouth.
apple.orientation: Knuckle touches the cheek; palm faces forward as it twists.
apple.framing: Keep the cheek and the twisting hand visible together.

bad.handshape: Flat open hand with fingers together.
bad.movement: Touch the fingertips to the chin, then flip the hand down and away.
bad.location: Start at the chin or lips.
bad.orientation: Palm starts facing the body and finishes facing down.
bad.framing: Keep the chin and the downward flip inside the frame.

bed.movement: Rest the palm against the cheek and tilt the head slightly into it.
bed.framing: Keep the face and the resting hand fully visible.

before.handshape: Both hands flat or gently bent.
before.movement: From the back of the non-dominant hand, move the dominant hand back toward the body.
before.framing: Keep both hands and the backward motion in the frame.

bird.handshape: Index finger and thumb form a small beak; other fingers closed.
bird.movement: Open and snap the beak closed.
bird.location: In front of the mouth or chin.
bird.framing: Keep the mouth and the beak handshape visible together.

boy.handshape: Flattened-O — fingers and thumb pinch together like grabbing a cap brim.
boy.movement: Close the fingers toward the thumb at the forehead.
boy.location: At the forehead, like the brim of a cap.
boy.framing: Keep the forehead and the pinching hand visible.

brother.handshape: Start with a flattened-O at the forehead; finish with both index fingers extended.
brother.movement: Tap the cap-brim grip at the forehead, then bring the hand down so both index fingers land side by side.
brother.orientation: Index fingers finish pointing forward, palms down.
brother.framing: Keep both the forehead start and the chest-level landing in frame.

brown.handshape: B handshape (flat palm, thumb tucked across the palm).
brown.movement: Slide the index-finger side of the hand down the cheek.
brown.location: Along the side of the cheek.
brown.orientation: Palm faces forward or to the side.
brown.framing: Keep the cheek and the sliding hand visible together.

call_on_phone.handshape: Y handshape — thumb and pinky extended, other fingers curled.
call_on_phone.movement: Bring the hand to the side of the head and hold it like a telephone.
call_on_phone.location: Thumb near the ear, pinky toward the mouth.
call_on_phone.framing: Keep the side of the face and the Y handshape visible.

can.movement: Move both fists firmly downward together once.
can.orientation: Knuckles face forward, palms down at the finish.
can.framing: Keep both fists visible through the downward press.

car.handshape: Both hands in fists gripping an imaginary steering wheel.
car.movement: Alternate the fists up and down like steering.
car.location: In front of the chest at wheel height.
car.orientation: Palms face each other on the wheel.
car.timing: Two or three steady steering rocks.
car.framing: Keep both fists inside the frame the whole time.

carrot.handshape: Fist, as if holding a carrot.
carrot.movement: Bring the fist toward the mouth and mimic biting motions.
carrot.orientation: Knuckles face out; the fist angles toward the mouth.
carrot.framing: Keep the mouth and the fist visible together.

cat.handshape: F handshape — thumb and index pinched, other fingers up.
cat.movement: Pinch near the cheek and pull outward like stroking a whisker.
cat.location: At the cheek beside the mouth.
cat.framing: Keep the cheek and the pinching fingers visible.

cereal.movement: Wiggle the bent finger across the chin from one side to the other.
cereal.framing: Keep the chin and the moving finger visible together.

chair.handshape: Both hands with index and middle fingers extended together (H/U shape).
chair.movement: Tap the dominant fingers down onto the other hand's fingers.
chair.orientation: Both palms face down; dominant fingers rest crosswise on the others.
chair.framing: Keep both hands centered and visible for the taps.

child.movement: Pat downward gently, as if resting on a child's head.
child.location: Low in the signing space, around waist height.
child.framing: Keep the low patting motion inside the bottom of the frame.

dog.handshape: Flat open hand, then a finger snap.
dog.movement: Pat the side of the thigh, then snap the fingers.
dog.timing: Pat then snap, in a relaxed rhythm.
dog.framing: Angle so the patting hand near the hip stays inside the frame.

drink.handshape: C handshape, as if holding a cup.
drink.movement: Tip the hand up toward the mouth like taking a drink.
drink.orientation: Palm faces the side; thumb toward the mouth.
drink.framing: Keep the mouth and the tipping cup-hand visible.

every.handshape: Both hands in A handshapes with thumbs up.
every.movement: Stroke the dominant hand down along the other hand's thumb side, repeatedly.
every.orientation: Both palms face the sides, thumbs up.
every.framing: Keep both fists and the stroking contact visible.

find.handshape: Open hand that closes into an F (thumb-index pinch).
find.movement: Reach down with the open hand, pinch, and lift up as if plucking something found.
find.location: From waist height up to chest height.
find.orientation: Palm starts facing down and lifts with the pinch facing up.
find.framing: Keep the downward reach and upward lift inside the frame.

fine.movement: Tap the thumb against the center of the chest.
fine.framing: Keep the chest and the spread hand visible.

fish.handshape: Flat open hand, fingers together, pointing forward.
fish.movement: Swim the hand forward with a gentle side-to-side wiggle.
fish.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
fish.orientation: Palm faces the side, like a fish's body.
fish.framing: Keep the whole swimming path inside the frame.

food.movement: Tap the fingertips to the lips.
food.framing: Keep the mouth and the tapping fingertips visible.

frog.handshape: Fist that flicks out the index and middle fingers.
frog.movement: From under the chin, flick the two fingers outward.
frog.framing: Keep the chin and the flicking fingers visible together.

girl.handshape: A handshape with the thumb extended.
girl.movement: Trace the thumb down along the jawline toward the chin.
girl.location: Along the jaw, from near the ear toward the chin.
girl.orientation: Palm faces the side of the face.
girl.framing: Keep the jawline and the tracing thumb visible.

give.handshape: Flattened-O hands, as if holding something small.
give.movement: Arc the hands forward and away from the body, as if handing something over.
give.orientation: Palms face up as the hands move out.
give.framing: Keep the full outward arc inside the frame.

go.movement: Rotate the fingers around each other while moving them away from the body.
go.orientation: Fingers finish pointing in the direction of travel.
go.framing: Keep both hands visible as they move forward.

grandma.movement: Touch the thumb to the chin, then bounce the hand forward in two small arcs.
grandma.location: Starts at the chin, moves forward.
grandma.framing: Keep the chin and the forward arcs inside the frame.

grandpa.movement: Touch the thumb to the forehead, then bounce the hand forward in two small arcs.
grandpa.location: Starts at the forehead, moves forward.
grandpa.framing: Keep the forehead and the forward arcs inside the frame.

hat.movement: Pat the top of the head.
hat.framing: Keep the top of the head inside the frame — step back if needed.

have.movement: Bring the fingertips in to land on the upper chest.
have.framing: Keep the chest and both hands visible at the landing.

home.movement: Touch the fingertips beside the mouth, then move up to touch the cheek.
home.framing: Keep the whole side of the face visible for both touches.

horse.handshape: Thumb extended at the temple with index and middle fingers up together.
horse.movement: Bend the two fingers forward and back like a horse's ear.
horse.framing: Keep the temple and the flicking fingers visible.

hot.movement: From the mouth, twist the hand sharply away and down, as if dropping something hot.
hot.orientation: Palm starts facing the mouth and turns away.
hot.framing: Keep the mouth and the quick outward twist inside the frame.

hungry.movement: Draw the hand down the center of the chest once.
hungry.location: From the upper chest toward the stomach.
hungry.framing: Keep the chest path of the hand fully visible.

later.handshape: L handshape — thumb and index extended.
later.movement: Pivot the index finger forward and down at the wrist, like a clock hand.
later.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
later.orientation: Palm starts facing forward; the index tips forward.
later.framing: Keep the pivoting L handshape large and visible.

like.handshape: Open hand that closes thumb and middle finger together.
like.movement: Pull the hand forward off the chest while the thumb and middle finger close.
like.location: Starts at the center of the chest.
like.orientation: Palm faces the chest, then the body of the hand moves forward.
like.framing: Keep the chest and the forward pull inside the frame.

listen.movement: Bring the cupped hand to the ear and hold it there.
listen.orientation: Palm faces forward, cupping behind the ear.
listen.framing: Keep the side of the head and the cupped hand visible.

look.handshape: V handshape — index and middle fingers extended.
look.movement: Point the fingers at the eyes, then turn them outward toward what you look at.
look.framing: Keep the eyes and the outward turn visible together.

mad.movement: Crumple the fingers inward in front of the face.
mad.framing: Keep the face and the clawed hand visible together.

make.handshape: Both hands in fists, one stacked on the other.
make.movement: Twist the stacked fists against each other, re-stack, and twist again.
make.orientation: Palms face the sides as the fists twist.
make.framing: Keep both fists centered and visible.

man.handshape: Open hand starting in a flattened-O grip, opening to a 5-hand.
man.movement: Grip an imaginary cap brim at the forehead, then bring the open hand down so the thumb lands on the chest.
man.framing: Keep both the forehead and the chest landing inside the frame.

morning.movement: Rest the non-dominant arm flat; raise the dominant forearm up behind it like the sun rising.
morning.location: The non-dominant hand rests near the dominant elbow.
morning.orientation: The rising palm faces up toward you.
morning.framing: Keep both arms inside the frame — this sign is wide.

night.handshape: Dominant hand bent at the knuckles; other arm flat.
night.movement: Arc the bent hand down over the edge of the flat arm, like the sun setting.
night.framing: Keep both the flat arm and the setting hand in frame.

not.handshape: A handshape with the thumb extended.
not.movement: Place the thumb under the chin and flick it forward and out.
not.orientation: Palm faces the side; thumb points back before the flick.
not.framing: Keep the chin and the outward flick visible.

now.handshape: Both hands bent, palms up (or Y handshapes).
now.movement: Drop both hands down a short distance together, once.
now.location: In front of the body at waist-to-chest height.
now.framing: Keep both hands visible at the drop.

open.handshape: Both flat B hands, side by side and touching.
open.movement: Rotate the hands apart, like double doors opening.
open.orientation: Palms start facing down and finish facing each other or up.
open.framing: Keep both hands visible through the opening motion.

orange.handshape: C handshape that squeezes into a fist.
orange.movement: Squeeze the hand closed in front of the chin, like juicing an orange.
orange.framing: Keep the chin and the squeezing hand visible.

pen.handshape: Thumb and index pinched, as if holding a pen.
pen.movement: Write a small wavy line across the other open palm.
pen.orientation: The writing palm faces up; the pen hand faces down.
pen.framing: Keep both hands centered so the writing motion is visible.

pencil.movement: Touch the pinched fingers near the mouth, then write across the other open palm.
pencil.location: Mouth first, then the non-dominant palm.
pencil.framing: Keep the mouth touch and the palm writing both inside the frame.

person.handshape: Both flat open hands, palms facing each other.
person.movement: Move both hands straight down together.
person.location: Shoulder width apart, from chest to waist height.
person.framing: Keep both hands visible through the full downward path.

read.handshape: V handshape pointed at the other open palm.
read.movement: Slide the V fingers down the palm, like eyes scanning a page.
read.orientation: The page palm faces up or toward you; the V points at it.
read.framing: Keep both hands centered so the scanning motion is clear.

room.movement: Hold the palms facing each other, then turn both so they face front-and-back, tracing a box.
room.orientation: Palms face each other first, then face the body and outward.
room.framing: Keep both hands in the frame as the box is traced.

sad.movement: Slide both hands down a short way in front of the face.
sad.framing: Keep the face visible between and behind the hands.

say.movement: Make small forward circles from the chin.
say.location: At the chin, in front of the mouth.
say.orientation: Fingertip points up and circles forward.
say.framing: Keep the mouth and the circling finger visible.

see.handshape: V handshape — index and middle fingers extended.
see.movement: From the eyes, move the hand straight forward.
see.orientation: Fingertips point at the eyes first, then forward.
see.framing: Keep the eyes and the forward motion visible.

shoe.movement: Knock the sides of the fists together.
shoe.location: In front of the body at waist-to-chest height.
shoe.framing: Keep both fists visible at the contact.

sick.handshape: Open 5-hand with the middle finger bent slightly in.
sick.movement: Touch the middle finger to the forehead.
sick.framing: Keep the forehead and the touching finger visible.

table.handshape: Both forearms flat, stacked like a tabletop.
table.movement: Tap the dominant forearm down onto the other forearm.
table.framing: Keep both forearms inside the frame — this sign is wide.

talk.movement: Move the hands alternately back and forth from the mouth.
talk.orientation: Fingertips point at the mouth and out.
talk.framing: Keep the mouth and both moving hands visible.

think.movement: Touch or make a small circle at the temple.
think.framing: Keep the forehead and the fingertip visible together.

thirsty.movement: Trace the fingertip down the front of the throat.
thirsty.location: Down the throat from chin to chest.
thirsty.framing: Keep the chin, throat, and finger path visible.

time.handshape: Bent index finger tapping; the other arm relaxed.
time.movement: Tap the bent finger on the back of the other wrist, like a wristwatch.
time.orientation: The tapped wrist faces down; the tapping palm faces down.
time.framing: Keep both wrists centered and visible.

tomorrow.handshape: A handshape with the thumb extended.
tomorrow.movement: From the chin or cheek, arc the thumb forward.
tomorrow.location: Starts at the side of the chin.
tomorrow.orientation: Palm faces the side; thumb leads the forward arc.
tomorrow.framing: Keep the cheek and the forward arc inside the frame.

where.movement: Shake the finger quickly side to side.
where.location: Neutral signing space at chest height.
where.framing: Keep the upright finger clearly visible against the background.

white.handshape: Open 5-hand that closes to a flattened-O.
white.movement: From fingertips on the chest, pull the hand away while closing the fingers.
white.location: Starts at the center of the chest.
white.orientation: Palm faces the chest, then pulls forward.
white.framing: Keep the chest and the closing pull inside the frame.

who.handshape: Bent index finger; thumb may rest at the chin.
who.movement: Flex the bent index finger a couple of times in front of the lips.
who.orientation: Palm faces the side; finger flexes toward you.
who.framing: Keep the mouth and the flexing finger visible.

why.handshape: Open hand at the forehead closing into a Y (thumb and pinky out).
why.movement: Touch the fingertips to the forehead, then pull down and away into the Y.
why.orientation: Palm faces the face, then turns toward you as the Y forms.
why.framing: Keep the forehead and the pull-away visible.

yesterday.handshape: Y handshape, or A with the thumb extended.
yesterday.movement: Touch the thumb to the chin, then arc it back toward the ear.
yesterday.location: From the chin back along the cheek.
yesterday.framing: Keep the whole cheek path inside the frame.

help.handshape: Dominant fist with thumb up, resting on the other flat palm.
help.orientation: The flat palm faces up under the fist.
help.framing: Keep both hands visible through the lift.

stop.handshape: Both hands flat; the dominant hand on edge.
stop.movement: Chop the edge of the dominant hand down onto the other palm, once.
stop.orientation: The bottom palm faces up; the chopping palm faces the side.
stop.framing: Keep both hands centered at the contact.

finish.movement: From palms facing the body, flip both hands outward.
finish.orientation: Palms start facing in and finish facing out.
finish.timing: One crisp flip, or two small ones.
finish.framing: Keep both hands inside the frame through the flip.

school.movement: Clap the dominant hand down onto the other palm.
school.orientation: The bottom palm faces up; the top palm faces down.
school.framing: Keep both hands centered and visible for the claps.

plus.movement: Cross one index finger over the other at a right angle.
plus.framing: Keep the crossing point centered in the frame.
